senses.titleCN: 对应关系：处于相同的关系位置
senses.definition: in a comparison, showing that two things change or behave in a corresponding way
senses.definitionCN: 在比较中表示两件事以对应的方式变化或表现
senses.example: The two curves rise likewise during the first quarter.
senses.exampleCN: 两条曲线在第一季度以相同的方式上升。
senses.why: Here the shared element is not the action itself but the relation: each curve behaves toward its own baseline the way the other does toward its own. The same form is mapped onto two separate tracks.
senses.whyCN: 这里共享的不是动作本身，而是关系：每条曲线相对自己的基线如何变化，另一条也以同样方式相对自己的基线变化。相同的“形”被投射到两条独立的轨道上。

senses.title: Open extension: and similar things
senses.titleCN: 开放列举：以及诸如此类
senses.definition: in the phrase and likewise, used to extend a list to other things of the same kind
senses.definitionCN: 用于 and likewise，把列举扩展到同类的其他事物
senses.example: The cupboard held flour, sugar, salt and likewise.
senses.exampleCN: 柜子里放着面粉、糖、盐以及诸如此类的东西。
senses.why: The same manner can widen from a single parallel case to an indefinite class: whatever else belongs to the same category is understood without being named.
senses.whyCN: “相同方式”可以从单个平行事例扩展到一整类：凡是属于同一范畴的东西，不必点名也自然被包括进来。

senses.title: Official parallel: the rule applies equally
senses.titleCN: 正式平行：规则同等适用于另一方
senses.definition: in formal or legal writing, used to apply the same rule, right, or duty to a second party
senses.definitionCN: 在正式或法律文本中，把同一规则、权利或义务同样施加于另一方
senses.example: The safety rules bind employees and likewise all contractors on site.
senses.exampleCN: 安全规定约束员工，也同样约束现场所有承包商。
senses.why: Official prose needs to bind two classes under one clause without repeating it. Likewise signals that the legal relation is copied exactly, which is why it is common in contracts and regulations.
senses.whyCN: 正式文本需要把两类主体绑进同一条款而不重复条文。likewise 表示这种法律关系被原样复制，因此常见于合同与规章。

senses.title: Usage boundary: affirmative parallels only
senses.titleCN: 用法边界：只接肯定性平行
senses.definition: a usage limit: likewise normally adds an affirmative parallel; in negative sentences English prefers either, neither, or nor
senses.definitionCN: 用法限制：likewise 通常追加肯定性的平行项；否定句中英语更常用 either、neither 或 nor
senses.example: He did not sign the letter, and his partner did not either.
senses.exampleCN: 他没有在信上签字，他的搭档也没有。
senses.why: The word asserts that the same thing holds, not that the same thing fails to hold. Negative addition needs a negative polarity item, so 'did not likewise' sounds odd to most speakers.
senses.whyCN: 这个词断定“同样的事成立”，而不是“同样的事不成立”。否定追加需要否定极性词，因此“did not likewise”在多数母语者听来不自然。

senses.title: Register boundary: formal in casual agreement
senses.titleCN: 语体边界：日常附和时偏正式
senses.definition: a register limit: in informal speech, same here or me too is more natural than likewise, which can sound formal or stiff
senses.definitionCN: 语体限制：非正式口语中 same here 或 me too 比 likewise 更自然，后者可能显得正式或生硬
senses.example: "I'm starving." "Same here."
senses.exampleCN: “我饿坏了。”“我也是。”
senses.why: Because likewise began as a written-style parallel marker, its reciprocal use retains a polished edge. Friends usually choose a lighter phrase unless they are deliberately dry or humorous.
senses.whyCN: 由于 likewise 原本是书面风格的平行标记，它的回应用法仍带着修饰过的味道。朋友之间通常选更轻的说法，除非故意显得冷淡或幽默。

intro.en: Likewise is a Germanic compound made in English from like and wise. Dates are approximate, and the deepest Indo-European origin of like is not known.
intro.cn: likewise 是英语用 like 与 wise 构成的日耳曼语复合词。年代为大致估计；like 最深的印欧语来源并不确定。

items.en: Like goes back to Old English gelic 'similar, having the same form', a word built with the prefix ge- and the noun lic, which could mean 'body, form'.
items.cn: like 可追溯到古英语 gelic“相似的、具有相同形体的”，由前缀 ge- 与名词 lic 构成，后者可表示“身体、形体”。

items.en: The Germanic source is reconstructed as *galika-, literally 'having the same form', from *ga- 'together' plus *likam 'body, form'. The body-to-form shift is the interesting part of the story. The deeper PIE origin of *likam is source uncertain.
items.cn: 其日耳曼来源被重构为 *galika-，字面义“具有相同的形体”，由 *ga-“一起”加 *likam“身体、形体”构成。从“身体”到“形体”的转移是这段词源里值得注意的地方。*likam 更深的原始印欧语来源不确定。

items.en: Wise meaning 'manner, way, condition' is a separate Old English noun. It is related to witan 'to know', so the original sense is close to 'the way one knows or does something'.
items.cn: 表示“方式、方法、状况”的 wise 是另一个古英语名词，与 witan“知道”同源，因此其原义接近“一个人认知或做事的方式”。

items.en: The two words combine into the adverb likewise, first recorded in the late 14c. with the sense 'in like manner'. The written compound fixes a phrase that earlier appeared as like wise.
items.cn: 这两个词合成了副词 likewise，14 世纪晚期最早记录，义为“以同样的方式”。这个书面复合词凝固了早先写作 like wise 的短语。

items.en: Modern English keeps 'in the same way' and adds the discourse senses 'also' and 'moreover'. The adverb never inflects, and its reciprocal use in conversation is a later, familiar extension.
items.cn: 现代英语保留“以同样方式”，并发展出“也、此外”的语篇义。这个副词没有屈折变化；会话中的回应用法是较晚出现的、偏口语的延伸。

note.en: The first group shares the -wise shape or the like root; the second group approaches the same meaning from manner, degree, addition, and formal continuation.
note.cn: 第一组共享 -wise 词形或 like 词根；第二组从方式、程度、追加和正式递进四个角度靠近同一含义。

entries.definition: the state of being similar, or a picture that looks like someone. It keeps like but has no wise.
entries.definitionCN: 相似的状态，或看起来像某人的画像。它保留 like，但没有 wise。

entries.definition: in a different way, or in other respects. It uses the same -wise suffix but points away from sameness.
entries.definitionCN: 以不同的方式，或在其他方面。它使用同一个 -wise 后缀，却指向“不相同”。

entries.definition: in the direction in which a clock's hands move. It shows -wise as a productive suffix meaning 'in the manner or direction of'.
entries.definitionCN: 沿钟表指针移动的方向。它显示 -wise 是能产后缀，表示“以……的方式或方向”。

entries.definition: in a similar way. It is the closest synonym, but it compares two cases more openly and is less tied to a written parallel.
entries.definitionCN: 以相似的方式。它是最接近的同义词，但更 openly 比较两个事例，也不像 likewise 那样绑定书面平行结构。

entries.definition: to the same amount or degree. It measures quantity or rank, not the method by which something is done.
entries.definitionCN: 以相同的数量或程度。它衡量数量或等级，而不是做某事的方法。

entries.definition: in addition; too. It adds a further item but does not claim that the two items behave in the same manner.
entries.definitionCN: 此外；也。它追加另一项，但不声称两项以相同方式表现。

entries.definition: in addition to what has been said, used to introduce a further point. It is formal and sequential, not a claim of identical manner.
entries.definitionCN: 除已说内容之外，用于引出进一步论点。它正式且表递进，不是“方式相同”的断言。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real parts like and wise, real fixed phrases, and real relatives such as otherwise and clockwise.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分 like 与 wise、真实固定短语，以及 otherwise、clockwise 等真实同族词。

normal.en: like means 'having the same form'; wise means 'manner'. Put them together and you get 'in the same manner'.
normal.cn: like 表示“具有相同形体”，wise 表示“方式”。合起来就是“以相同的方式”。

normal.en: The suffix -wise is still alive in otherwise, clockwise, and lengthwise, all meaning 'in the manner or direction of'.
normal.cn: 后缀 -wise 仍活在 otherwise、clockwise、lengthwise 中，都表示“以……的方式或方向”。

normal.en: Do likewise is a fixed phrase: whatever the first person did, the second repeats.
normal.cn: do likewise 是固定短语：第一个人怎么做，第二个人就照样做。

normal.en: As a one-word reply, Likewise means 'the same to you' and returns the wish you just received.
normal.cn: 作为一词回应，Likewise 意为“你也一样”，把刚收到的祝愿原样送还。

normal.en: And likewise at the end of a list means 'and other things of the same kind'.
normal.cn: and likewise 放在列举末尾，表示“以及同类的其他东西”。

abstract.en: Imagine one seal pressed twice: the second impression is not the first object, but it carries exactly the same shape.
abstract.cn: 想象同一枚印章压两次：第二个印痕不是第一个物体，却带着完全相同的形状。

abstract.en: A mirror placed beside an action: whatever the first body does, the second repeats in its own material.
abstract.cn: 在动作旁边立一面镜子：第一个身体做什么，第二个就在自己的材料里重复什么。

abstract.en: Two parallel tracks: they are separate roads, but every turn on one is matched by a turn on the other.
abstract.cn: 两条平行轨道：它们是各自独立的道路，但一条上的每次转弯，另一条都有对应的转弯。

examples.en: The first team simplified its forms, and the second team did likewise.
examples.cn: 第一组简化了表单，第二组也照样做了。

examples.en: The vaccine protects children; likewise, it reduces transmission in adults.
examples.cn: 疫苗保护儿童；同样地，它也减少成人的传播。

examples.en: "Thanks for your help." "Likewise."
examples.cn: “谢谢你的帮助。”“彼此彼此。”

dict_mnemonic.text: “来客歪姿”——来客摆出和别人一样歪的姿势 → likewise 同样地

root: 古英语 gelic“具有相同形体”+ wise“方式”，字面义“以相同的方式”；核心是“照着同一个形状再做一遍”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of likewise, all from one compound: like supplies the same shape, wise supplies the manner, and the pair is then extended to addition, discourse, reply, correspondence, open lists, official rules, and two usage limits.
sensesIntro.cn: likewise 的九个义项都出自同一个复合词：like 提供相同的形，wise 提供方式；这一对成分随后延伸到追加、语篇、回应、对应关系、开放列举、正式规则，以及两条用法边界。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same shape is carried over into a second act.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一个形状被带进第二个行为里。

branches.en: MANNER AND CORRESPONDENCE: one method is copied, or two things occupy matching positions.
branches.cn: 方式与对应：一种做法被复制，或两件事占据相互对应的位置。

branches.en: PARALLEL APPLICATION: the same predicate is applied to a second item, a second clause, or a second legal party.
branches.cn: 平行适用：同一个说法被施加于第二项、第二句或第二个法律主体。

branches.en: RECIPROCAL REPLY: the comparison turns back and returns the wish to the speaker.
branches.cn: 回应：比较方向转回，把祝愿送还给说话者。

branches.en: OPEN CLASS: the same kind is left open, so the list can continue without naming every member.
branches.cn: 开放类别：同类范围保持开放，列举不必点出每一个成员。

branches.en: BOUNDARIES: affirmative polarity and formal register limit where the adverb sounds natural.
branches.cn: 边界：肯定极性与正式语体限制了该副词听起来自然的范围。

intro.en: Likewise is a Germanic compound, not a Latin derivative. Like supplies the 'same form' and -wise is the noun 'manner' acting as the second element of a compound.
intro.cn: likewise 是日耳曼语复合词，不是拉丁语派生词。like 提供“相同形体”，-wise 则是充当复合词第二成分的名词“方式”。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin cognate family here: like and wise are Germanic. The four entries below are the genuine Germanic relatives, including the still-productive -wise suffix and the wit family behind wise.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁同族词：like 与 wise 都是日耳曼语词。下面四条是真正的日耳曼同族词，包括仍有能产力的 -wise 后缀，以及 wise 背后与“知道”相关的 wit 词族。

items.meaning: in the same way; also
items.meaningCN: 以同样的方式；也（like 表相同形体，-wise 表方式）
items.example: He nodded, and she did likewise.
items.exampleCN: 他点了点头，她也照样做了。

items.meaning: the quality of being similar; a portrait
items.meaningCN: 相似；相像；画像（-ness 构成状态或性质名词）
items.example: There is a strong likeness between the two brothers.
items.exampleCN: 两兄弟长得很像。

items.meaning: pleasant and easy to like
items.meaningCN: 讨人喜欢的；可爱的（-able 表示“能够被……”）
items.example: She is a likeable and patient teacher.
items.exampleCN: 她是一位讨人喜欢又有耐心的老师。

items.meaning: a feeling of enjoying something
items.meaningCN: 喜爱；喜好（-ing 构成情感名词）
items.example: He has a liking for old maps.
items.exampleCN: 他喜爱旧地图。

items.meaning: similar, alike
items.example: The first half of the word is this old adjective.
items.exampleCN: 这个词的前半就是这个古老的形容词。

items.structure: Old English wise 'manner', used as a suffix
items.meaning: in the manner of; as regards
items.example: The same suffix forms clockwise and lengthwise.
items.exampleCN: 同一后缀还构成 clockwise 与 lengthwise。

items.meaning: way, manner, custom
items.example: The noun still survives inside the suffix.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词仍活在后缀里。

items.meaning: to compare one thing to another
items.example: The critic likened the novel to a long letter.
items.exampleCN: 评论家把这部小说比作一封长信。

items.meaning: having similar opinions
items.example: The club attracts like-minded readers.
items.exampleCN: 这个俱乐部吸引志趣相投的读者。

latinEntries.meaning: similar to each other
latinEntries.meaningCN: 相似的；同样地（a- 加 like“形体”）

latinEntries.meaning: of the same kind or place
latinEntries.meaningCN: 同一类的；同一地方的（源自古英语 ilca“相同”）

latinEntries.meaning: way or manner, surviving mainly in compounds
latinEntries.meaningCN: 方式；方法（主要保留在复合词中）

latinEntries.meaning: intelligence; the ability to know
latinEntries.meaningCN: 才智；知道的能力（与 wise 同源）

definition_zh: 链环；连接物；纽带；连接；关联；链接
definition_en: one ring of a chain; something that joins two things; to connect or associate people, objects, or ideas
core_image: 两段铁链由中间一个环扣住，环环相扣，力量沿链条传递
scene: 铁路调度室里，调度员把两个货运站接进同一条新支线。He used the panel to link the two freight yards to the new branch line, and a green line appeared between the two dots.
sceneCN: 这里 link 是「把两点连成一条线路」（第 6 个义项：交通连线）；句意：他用调度台把两个货运站连到新支线上，屏幕上两点之间多出一条绿线。图中可辨识物件：铁路线路图、两个货运站标记、新支线绿线、调度台。

pos.zh: 链环；连接物；纽带；联系
连接；联系；把……串起来

collocations.phrase: a link between A and B
collocations.zh: A 与 B 之间的联系
把 A 连接到 B

senses.title: Chain ring: one loop in a chain
senses.titleCN: 链环：链条中的单个环
senses.definition: a single ring of metal that forms one unit of a chain
senses.definitionCN: 构成链条一个单元的单个金属环
senses.example: One link of the chain had rusted through.
senses.exampleCN: 链条上有一个环已经锈穿了。
senses.why: The earliest English sense is the physical ring. Everything else grows from this object: a chain is a row of rings, and each ring holds the next.
senses.whyCN: 英语最早的义项就是这种实体环。其余义项都从这一物件生长出来：链条是一排环，而每个环都扣住下一个。

senses.title: Connector: a piece that joins two ends
senses.titleCN: 连接件：把两端扣在一起的部件
senses.definition: a physical part or device that fastens two separate parts together
senses.definitionCN: 把两个分离部件扣合在一起的实体部件或装置
senses.example: A steel link joined the two sections of the fence.
senses.exampleCN: 一个钢制连接件把围栏的两段接了起来。
senses.why: A chain ring already does the work of holding two neighbours. The word is therefore ready to name any small piece whose job is to join two ends.
senses.whyCN: 链环本来就在承担“扣住左右两环”的工作。因此这个词很自然地可以指任何以“接合两端”为职责的小部件。

senses.title: Bond between people or groups
senses.titleCN: 纽带：人与人、群体与群体之间的联结
senses.definition: a relationship or connection between people, groups, or organizations
senses.definitionCN: 人与人、群体或组织之间的关系或联结
senses.example: The exchange programme created a lasting link between the two schools.
senses.exampleCN: 交换项目在两所学校之间建立了持久的纽带。
senses.why: Move from metal to society: the ring that held two chain ends now holds two people or institutions. The connection is no longer visible, but it still constrains and carries.
senses.whyCN: 从金属转向社会：原本扣住两节链子的环，现在扣住两个人或两个机构。联结不再可见，但仍在约束与传递。

senses.title: Join physically: connect two things
senses.titleCN: 实体连接：把两件东西接起来
senses.definition: to connect two objects or places so that they are joined or can work together
senses.definitionCN: 把两个物体或地点连接起来，使其接合或能协同运作
senses.example: Workers linked the new pipe to the old water main.
senses.exampleCN: 工人把新管道接到旧的总水管上。
senses.why: The noun turns into a verb: to link is to act as the ring, putting oneself or a part between two ends and holding them together.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词：link 就是充当那个环，把自己或某个部件放在两端之间，把它们扣住。

senses.title: Associate ideas or evidence
senses.titleCN: 关联：把观念、证据或因果串起来
senses.definition: to show or establish a connection between ideas, facts, or causes
senses.definitionCN: 表明或建立观念、事实或原因之间的联系
senses.example: The study links long commutes to higher stress levels.
senses.exampleCN: 这项研究把长途通勤与更高的压力水平联系起来。
senses.why: A chain of reasoning is also a row of rings: each claim holds the next. To link two facts is to insert the ring that makes them one sequence rather than two isolated items.
senses.whyCN: 推理链同样是一排环：每个论断扣住下一个。把两个事实 link 起来，就是插入那个让它们成为一条序列、而非两个孤立项的环。

senses.title: Transport connection: a route between two points
senses.titleCN: 交通连线：连接两点的线路
senses.definition: a transport route or service that connects two places
senses.definitionCN: 连接两地的交通路线或运输服务
senses.example: The new rail link cuts the journey to forty minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 新的铁路连线把行程缩短到四十分钟。
senses.why: Two stations are like two chain ends; the rail line is the ring that joins them into one network. The image scales from a hand-held chain to a map.
senses.whyCN: 两个车站就像链条的两端，铁路线则是把二者接入同一网络的环。这个意象从手中的链条放大到地图上。

senses.title: Digital link: hyperlink or network connection
senses.titleCN: 数字链接：超链接或网络连接
senses.definition: a hyperlink in a document, or a connection between computers or network nodes
senses.definitionCN: 文档中的超链接，或计算机、网络节点之间的连接
senses.example: Click the link to open the full report.
senses.exampleCN: 点击链接打开完整报告。
senses.why: A webpage is a node and a hyperlink is the ring that carries a reader from one page to another. The same join-and-carry structure is now made of protocol rather than metal.
senses.whyCN: 网页是一个节点，超链接则是把读者从一页带到另一页的环。同样的“接合与传递”结构，如今由协议而不是金属构成。

senses.title: Link arms: join bodies in contact
senses.titleCN: 挽臂：身体相接
senses.definition: to join arms or hands with someone, especially as a sign of closeness or support
senses.definitionCN: 与某人挽臂或牵手，尤表示亲近或相互支持
senses.example: The two friends linked arms and walked into the hall.
senses.exampleCN: 两个朋友挽着手臂走进大厅。
senses.why: Here the human body supplies both ends: bent arms form the rings. The verb returns to its most concrete physical action while keeping the idea of mutual holding.
senses.whyCN: 这里两端都由人体提供：弯起的手臂就是环。动词回到最具体的身体动作，同时保留“相互扣住”的意思。

senses.title: Missing link: the absent ring in a sequence
senses.titleCN: 缺环：序列中缺失的一环
senses.definition: in the phrase missing link, the absent piece needed to complete an evolutionary or logical chain
senses.definitionCN: 用于 missing link，指完成演化链或论证链所缺的那一环
senses.example: The fossil was hailed as the missing link between the two species.
senses.exampleCN: 这块化石被誉为两个物种之间缺失的一环。
senses.why: If a chain is only as strong as its rings, one absent ring breaks the sequence. The phrase turns a physical gap into a metaphor for an unexplained step.
senses.whyCN: 如果链条的强度取决于每一环，那么缺一个环就断了整条序列。这个短语把实体缺口变成了“无法解释的中间步骤”的隐喻。

senses.title: Link up: separate parts meet and join
senses.titleCN: 汇合：分开的部分相遇并联结
senses.definition: in the phrasal verb link up, to join or meet after being separate
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语动词 link up，表示原本分开的部分连接或会合
senses.example: The two rescue teams linked up at the tunnel entrance.
senses.exampleCN: 两支救援队在隧道口会合了。
senses.why: The particle up adds completion: the ring is not merely placed but closed. Separate parties become one continuous chain, which is why the phrase suits meetings and mergers.
senses.whyCN: 小品词 up 补充“完成”：环不只是放上去，而是扣合封闭。分开的各方变成一条连续的链，因此这个短语适合会合与合并。

intro.en: Link was borrowed from Old Norse, not inherited from Old English. The chain-ring sense is solid; the jump to a bend root in Indo-European is generally believed rather than proved.
intro.cn: link 是从古诺斯语借入的，而不是从古英语继承的。链环义很确定；上溯到印欧语“弯曲”词根则属于一般认为是，而非已经证明。

items.en: The noun probably comes from Old Norse hlekkr 'link of a chain', with a related verb hlekkja 'to chain'. Old Norse gave English many everyday words during the Viking period.
items.cn: 名词很可能来自古诺斯语 hlekkr“链环”，并有相关动词 hlekkja“用链子拴住”。维京时期古诺斯语给英语带来了大量日常词。

items.en: The Norse word is traced to Proto-Germanic *hlankiz, a formation from a root meaning 'to bend'. A ring is metal bent back on itself.
items.cn: 这个诺斯语词可追溯到原始日耳曼语 *hlankiz，由表示“弯曲”的词根构成。环就是金属弯回自身形成的形状。

items.en: The deeper source is generally believed to be PIE *kleng- 'to bend, turn'. The same family is often linked to angle and other bend words, but the reconstruction is not certain.
items.cn: 更深的来源一般认为是原始印欧语 *kleng-“弯曲、转折”。同一词族常被与 angle 等“弯折”词联系起来，但这一重构并不确定。

items.en: English records the noun in the early 15c. and the verb in the late 14c., first in the literal sense of fitting with chain links.
items.cn: 英语中名词最早记录于 15 世纪早期，动词记录于 14 世纪晚期，最初都是“装上链环”的字面义。

items.en: From a metal ring the word extends to any connection: rail links, personal links, links between facts, and finally hyperlinks. The chain image survives in missing link and weakest link.
items.cn: 从金属环出发，这个词扩展到任何连接：铁路连线、人际纽带、事实之间的关联，最后是超链接。链条意象仍活在 missing link 与 weakest link 中。

note.en: The first group tests spelling and derivation around link; the second separates four kinds of connection by strength, direction, and domain.
note.cn: 第一组检查 link 周围的拼写与派生关系；第二组按强度、方向和领域区分四种“连接”。

entries.definition: the act or system of linking; a mechanical or genetic connection. It is link plus the noun suffix -age.
entries.definitionCN: 连接行为或连接系统；机械或遗传上的联动。它是 link 加名词后缀 -age。

entries.definition: to shut and open the eyes quickly. It rhymes and looks close but has a different, uncertain origin.
entries.definitionCN: 快速眨眼。它押韵、词形接近，但来源不同且不确定。

entries.definition: coloured liquid used for writing or printing. It shares the -ink ending only; there is no link in it.
entries.definitionCN: 用于书写或印刷的彩色液体。它只共享 -ink 结尾，与 link 没有词源关系。

entries.definition: to join two things so that they touch or work together. It is the broad neutral verb, while link often suggests a chain-like intermediate part.
entries.definitionCN: 把两物接合，使其接触或协同运作。它是最宽泛中性的动词，而 link 常暗示有一个链环式的中间部件。

entries.definition: to fasten one thing to another, usually a smaller thing to a larger one. It stresses physical fixing, not mutual relationship.
entries.definitionCN: 把一物固定到另一物上，通常是小物附于大物。它强调实体固定，而不是相互关联。

entries.definition: to tie or fasten tightly, or to place under a moral or legal obligation. It is stronger and more restrictive than link.
entries.definitionCN: 紧紧捆扎或固定，或使承担道德、法律义务。它比 link 更强、更具约束力。

entries.definition: the way two people or groups are connected and behave toward each other. It names the durable social tie that link describes.
entries.definitionCN: 两个人或群体相互连接与相处的方式。它命名了 link 所描述的那种持久社会纽带。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the physical chain ring, the fixed phrases missing link and weakest link, and the modern hyperlink.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：实体的链环、固定短语 missing link 与 weakest link，以及现代的超链接。

normal.en: A chain is a row of rings; one ring is a link. Take one out and the chain falls apart.
normal.cn: 链条是一排环，一个环就是一个 link。取走一个，整条链就散了。

normal.en: The weakest link is the ring that breaks first, so the phrase means the most vulnerable part of any system.
normal.cn: weakest link 是最先断的那个环，因此这个短语指任何系统中最脆弱的部分。

normal.en: The missing link is the ring absent from a sequence, especially an evolutionary chain.
normal.cn: missing link 是序列中缺失的那个环，尤指演化链上的缺环。

normal.en: Link up means the ring is finally closed: two separate parties meet and become one chain.
normal.cn: link up 表示环终于扣合：两个分开的方会合，变成一条链。

normal.en: A hyperlink does the same job on the web: one click carries you from one page to the next.
normal.cn: 超链接在网络上做同一件事：一次点击把你从一页带到下一页。

abstract.en: Two islands with a bridge between them: the bridge is not either island, yet without it they are separate worlds.
abstract.cn: 两座岛之间有一座桥：桥不属于任何一座岛，但没有它，两座岛就是分开的世界。

abstract.en: A chain has no centre: every ring holds the next and is held by the previous, so the link is a position rather than a thing.
abstract.cn: 链条没有中心：每个环都扣住下一个，又被上一个扣住，因此“环”是一种位置，而不是一个孤立物件。

abstract.en: A web of nodes and edges: the nodes are what we see, the links are the invisible lines along which influence travels.
abstract.cn: 由节点和边构成的网：节点是我们看得见的东西，链接则是影响沿之传递的看不见的线。

examples.en: The bridge links the island to the mainland.
examples.cn: 这座桥把海岛与大陆连接起来。

examples.en: Researchers have found a link between sleep loss and poor memory.
examples.cn: 研究者发现睡眠不足与记忆力差之间存在关联。

examples.en: Send me the link to the recording when it is ready.
examples.cn: 录音准备好后把链接发给我。

dict_mnemonic.text: “林克”——游戏主角林克把地图上的各个地点串起来 → link 连接

root: 古诺斯语 hlekkr“链环”，原始日耳曼语 *hlankiz；核心是“一环扣一环”，引申为任何连接、纽带与关联。

sensesIntro.en: Ten senses of link, all built on one object: a ring that holds two ends together. The ring becomes a connector, a human bond, a route, a hyperlink, a missing step, and finally the act of closing the chain.
sensesIntro.cn: link 的十个义项都建立在一个物件上：把两端扣住的环。这个环变成连接件、人际纽带、线路、超链接、缺失的步骤，最后变成“把链扣合”的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one ring holds the ring before it and the ring after it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个环同时扣住前一个环与后一个环。

branches.en: PHYSICAL RING: the literal chain link and any part that fastens two ends.
branches.cn: 实体环：字面的链环，以及任何接合两端的部件。

branches.en: HUMAN CONTACT: the ring becomes a bond between people or a joining of arms.
branches.cn: 人际接触：环变成人与人之间的纽带，或手臂的相互扣住。

branches.en: INFRASTRUCTURE: pipes, rails and routes are rings that join places into a network.
branches.cn: 基础设施：管道、铁路与航线都是把地点接入网络的环。

branches.en: LOGICAL CHAIN: facts are linked like rings, and a missing ring explains why a sequence fails.
branches.cn: 逻辑链：事实像环一样被串起，缺环则解释了序列为何断裂。

branches.en: DIGITAL AND COMPLETION: a hyperlink carries a reader, and link up closes the ring.
branches.cn: 数字与完成：超链接把读者带过去，link up 则把环扣合封闭。

intro.en: Link is a borrowed Germanic noun and verb, not a prefixed Latin word. English adds -age, -ed, -er and -ing to build its family.
intro.cn: link 是借入的日耳曼语名词兼动词，不是带前缀的拉丁词。英语通过 -age、-ed、-er、-ing 构成它的词族。

latinIntro.en: Link has no Latin ancestor. If the Indo-European bend root *kleng- is correct, it is a distant cousin of angle, ankle and anchor, but that link is generally believed rather than established.
latinIntro.cn: link 没有拉丁语祖先。如果印欧语“弯曲”词根 *kleng- 成立，它与 angle、ankle、anchor 是远亲，但这一联系只是一般认为，并未确立。

items.meaning: the act or system of linking; a mechanical or genetic connection
items.meaningCN: 连接；联系；联动机制（-age 构成行为或系统名词）
items.example: The linkage between the two levers controls the brake.
items.exampleCN: 两根杠杆之间的联动机构控制刹车。

items.meaning: joined or connected
items.meaningCN: 相连的；有关联的（-ed 构成形容词）
items.example: The two problems are closely linked.
items.exampleCN: 这两个问题密切相关。

items.meaning: a program or device that joins separate pieces
items.meaningCN: 连接程序；链接器（-er 表示执行该动作的物）
items.example: The linker combines the object files into one program.
items.exampleCN: 链接器把多个目标文件合并成一个程序。

items.meaning: the act of connecting; serving to connect
items.meaningCN: 连接；起连接作用的（-ing 构成动作或功能词）
items.example: A linking verb joins a subject to its description.
items.exampleCN: 连系动词把主语与其描述连接起来。

items.meaning: a collective or result noun
items.example: It forms linkage, a set of connections.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 linkage，即一组连接。

items.meaning: to undo a connection
items.example: You can unlink the file from the message.
items.exampleCN: 你可以把文件从消息里解除链接。

items.meaning: to connect with one another
items.example: The two networks are interlinked.
items.exampleCN: 这两个网络互相连接。

items.meaning: a clickable cross-reference on a page
items.example: Click the hyperlink to open the source.
items.exampleCN: 点击超链接打开出处。

items.meaning: a joining of two systems or groups
items.example: The rail link-up took ten years to complete.
items.exampleCN: 这条铁路的接轨花了十年才完成。

latinEntries.meaning: a corner or the space between two lines
latinEntries.meaningCN: 角；两条线之间的空间（与“弯曲”词根有远亲关系）

latinEntries.structure: Old English ancleow, from PIE *ang- (to bend)
latinEntries.meaning: the joint where the foot bends
latinEntries.meaningCN: 踝；脚弯曲处的关节

latinEntries.meaning: a heavy device that holds a ship in place
latinEntries.meaningCN: 锚；把船固定住的重物（原义与“弯钩”有关）

latinEntries.meaning: a three-cornered plane figure
latinEntries.meaningCN: 三角形；有三个角的平面图形

definition_zh: 找出……的位置；位于；安置；设立；定位
definition_en: to find the exact position of something, to place it in a position, or to be situated in a place
core_image: 一张摊开的地图上，一枚图钉被按在某个精确的坐标点上
scene: 维修员戴上耳机，用测漏仪贴着墙面慢慢移动。The needle jumped near the bathroom wall, and that was enough to locate the broken pipe behind the tiles.
sceneCN: 这里 locate 是「找出确切位置」（第 1 个义项：确定某物的位置）；句意：指针在浴室墙边突然跳动，这样就足以找出瓷砖后面那截破裂的水管。图中可辨识物件：测漏仪、耳机、墙面记号、水管剖面图。

pos.zh: 找出……的位置；使坐落于；安置；设立
位于；定居（多用于 be located）

senses.title: Find the exact position of something
senses.titleCN: 找出某物的确切位置
senses.definition: to discover the exact place where someone or something is
senses.definitionCN: 发现某人或某物所在的确切地点
senses.example: Rescuers used heat sensors to locate the trapped climbers.
senses.exampleCN: 救援人员用热传感器找到了受困登山者的位置。
senses.why: Latin locare meant 'to place', and locus meant 'place'. The modern verb starts by finding the place that belongs to a person or object: the pin is put back on the map.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 locare 意为“放置”，locus 意为“地点”。现代动词的起点是找到某人或某物所属的那个地点：把图钉重新按回地图上。

senses.title: Be situated: occupy a place
senses.titleCN: 位于：占据某个地点
senses.definition: in the passive be located, to be situated in a particular place
senses.definitionCN: 用于被动式 be located，表示位于某个特定地点
senses.example: The laboratory is located on the third floor.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室位于三楼。
senses.why: Once a thing has been placed, the result of that placing is a position. English prefers the passive be located for this state, because the place, not the placer, is what matters.
senses.whyCN: 某物被放置之后，放置的结果就是一个位置。英语用被动式 be located 表达这种状态，因为重要的是地点，而不是放置者。

senses.title: Place something deliberately
senses.titleCN: 安置：有意把某物放在某处
senses.definition: to put or fix something in a particular position, especially as part of a plan
senses.definitionCN: 把某物放置或固定在特定位置，尤作为计划的一部分
senses.example: Engineers located the sensor where the pipe bends.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师把传感器安置在管道弯曲处。
senses.why: This sense returns to the Latin verb's active core: locare is to place. The object is not merely found but deliberately given a position.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项回到拉丁动词的主动核心：locare 就是放置。对象不是被找到，而是被有意赋予一个位置。

senses.title: Establish a business or branch in a place
senses.titleCN: 设立：把机构或分支落户某地
senses.definition: to establish an office, factory, or organization in a particular place
senses.definitionCN: 在某地设立办事处、工厂或组织
senses.example: The company located its regional office near the port.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司把地区办事处设在港口附近。
senses.why: A business chooses a place and then settles there. The verb shifts from a single object to an institution that occupies a site, a common use in commerce and planning.
senses.whyCN: 企业先选择一个地点，然后在那里落脚。动词的宾语从单个物件变成占据场地的机构，这是商业与规划中的常见用法。

senses.title: Pinpoint a fault or cause
senses.titleCN: 确定故障或问题的所在
senses.definition: to identify the exact source of a problem, fault, or pain
senses.definitionCN: 确定问题、故障或疼痛的确切来源
senses.example: The technician located the fault in a single connector.
senses.exampleCN: 技术员把故障定位到一个连接器上。
senses.why: A fault is invisible until it is assigned to a point. Locating it means narrowing the search until one place on the system carries the explanation.
senses.whyCN: 故障在被指认到某个点之前是不可见的。定位故障，就是把搜索范围收窄，直到系统上的某一处承载了解释。

senses.title: Technical positioning: radar, sonar, GPS
senses.titleCN: 技术定位：雷达、声呐与全球定位
senses.definition: to determine the position of an object or signal using an instrument
senses.definitionCN: 用仪器确定物体或信号的位置
senses.example: The system locates the drone within ten metres.
senses.exampleCN: 该系统能把无人机定位在十米范围内。
senses.why: Instruments extend the search: a signal is sent, an echo returns, and the delay is converted into coordinates. The old 'place' is now a mathematical point in space.
senses.whyCN: 仪器延伸了搜索：发出信号、收到回波，再把延迟换算成坐标。原来的“地点”如今成了空间中的数学点。

senses.title: Find a passage inside a larger whole
senses.titleCN: 在整体中查到某一处
senses.definition: to find a particular passage, file, or item within a larger document or system
senses.definitionCN: 在较大的文档或系统中找到特定段落、文件或条目
senses.example: She located the relevant paragraph in the online manual.
senses.exampleCN: 她在在线手册中找到了相关段落。
senses.why: The 'map' can be a book, a database, or a filing system. Locating is not discovering a new thing but putting your finger on the known place where it sits.
senses.whyCN: 这里的“地图”可以是书、数据库或档案系统。定位不是发现新东西，而是把手指按到它已知所在的那个位置。

senses.title: Map a gene to a chromosome
senses.titleCN: 基因定位：把基因标到染色体上
senses.definition: in genetics, to determine the position of a gene or sequence on a chromosome
senses.definitionCN: 在遗传学中，确定基因或序列在染色体上的位置
senses.example: The team located the mutation on the long arm of chromosome 7.
senses.exampleCN: 团队把该突变定位在 7 号染色体的长臂上。
senses.why: A chromosome is a linear map, and a gene has an address on it. This specialist sense applies the same 'find its place' structure to molecular coordinates.
senses.whyCN: 染色体是一张线性的地图，基因在上面有地址。这个专业义项把同样的“找到它的位置”结构用于分子坐标。

senses.title: Usage boundary: pinpoint, not merely encounter
senses.titleCN: 用法边界：强调精确定位，而非偶然遇到
senses.definition: a usage limit: locate stresses an exact position; find is broader, and be located describes a state rather than an action
senses.definitionCN: 用法限制：locate 强调确切位置；find 范围更宽；be located 描述状态而不是动作
senses.example: I found an old letter in the drawer, but I could not locate the address on any map.
senses.exampleCN: 我在抽屉里发现一封旧信，却无法在任何地图上确定那个地址的位置。
senses.why: Finding can be accidental and can concern anything; locating requires a position that can be specified. The passive state also blocks the progressive in ordinary description, so 'is located' replaces 'is locating'.
senses.whyCN: find 可以是偶然的，也可以针对任何东西；locate 则要求一个能被指明的位置。被动状态在通常描述中也不用进行体，因此用 is located 而不是 is locating。

intro.en: Locate comes from Latin locus 'place' through the verb locare 'to place'. The English verb is early modern, while the 'find the position' sense is much later. The deeper origin of locus is uncertain.
intro.cn: locate 经由拉丁动词 locare“放置”来自拉丁名词 locus“地点”。英语动词出现于近代早期，而“找出位置”的义项要晚得多。locus 更深层的来源并不确定。

items.en: Latin locus meant 'a place, spot, position'. It also developed the sense 'passage in a book', because a text is a kind of place one visits. Its deeper PIE origin is source uncertain.
items.cn: 拉丁语 locus 意为“地点、位置”，还发展出“书中的段落”义，因为文本也是一种可以被造访的地方。它更深的原始印欧语来源不确定。

items.en: From locus came locare 'to place, put, set'. The verb also meant 'to let out for hire', which survives in the leasing sense of location in some languages.
items.cn: 由 locus 产生 locare“放置、安放”。这个动词还表示“出租”，这一义项在一些语言中保留在 location 的租赁义里。

items.en: English adopts locate in the 17c. with the sense 'to place or establish in a position'. It is a learned Latin borrowing, not an inherited word.
items.cn: 英语在 17 世纪引入 locate，义为“放置或安置于某位置”。它是学术性的拉丁借词，不是继承词。

items.en: The sense 'to find the exact position of' is recorded in the late 19c., first associated with surveying and marking land in North America.
items.cn: “找出确切位置”这一义项记录于 19 世纪晚期，最初与北美土地测量和标界有关。

items.en: Modern English extends locate to faults, files, signals, and genes. Be located becomes the standard way to state where a building or institution stands.
items.cn: 现代英语把 locate 扩展到故障、文件、信号和基因。be located 成为说明建筑或机构坐落何处的标准说法。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin place root or the loc- shape; the second separates finding, situating, positioning, and detecting.
note.cn: 第一组共享拉丁语“地点”词根或 loc- 词形；第二组区分“找到”“坐落”“安置”和“探测”。

entries.definition: a place or position, or the act of placing something. It is the noun built directly on locate.
entries.definitionCN: 地点、位置，或放置的行为。它是直接由 locate 构成的名词。

entries.definition: a particular area or neighbourhood. It comes from local plus -ity, both from locus.
entries.definitionCN: 特定地区或街区。它由 local 加 -ity 构成，二者都出自 locus。

entries.definition: a railway engine. It joins locus 'place' with movere 'to move', so it moves from place to place, not from locate.
entries.definitionCN: 铁路机车。它把 locus“地点”与 movere“移动”结合，表示“从一地移到另一地”，并非来自 locate。

entries.definition: to discover something, often by chance or after searching. It is broader than locate and does not require an exact position.
entries.definitionCN: 发现某物，常是偶然或经搜寻而得到。它比 locate 宽泛，不要求确切位置。

entries.definition: to place something in a particular context or position. It is formal and common in the passive, like be situated.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物置于特定语境或位置。它较正式，常像 be situated 一样用于被动。

entries.definition: to put something in a chosen place. It stresses the choice of placement rather than the search for coordinates.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物放在选定的位置。它强调有意的摆放，而不是寻找坐标。

entries.definition: to discover that something is present, often with an instrument. It reports presence, while locate reports position.
entries.definitionCN: 发现某物存在，常用仪器。它报告“存在”，而 locate 报告“位置”。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the Latin place word locus, the everyday phrase be located in, and the modern locator and GPS.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：拉丁语地点词 locus、日常短语 be located in，以及现代的 locator 与 GPS。

normal.en: Locus means 'place'; locate is the verb that gives something a place or finds the place it has.
normal.cn: locus 意为“地点”；locate 就是给某物一个地点，或找到它已有的地点。

normal.en: Be located in is the standard phrase for where a building, office, or city stands.
normal.cn: be located in 是说明建筑、办事处或城市坐落何处的标准短语。

normal.en: To locate a fault is to put a finger on the exact point where a system fails.
normal.cn: locate a fault 就是把手指按到系统失效的那个确切点上。

normal.en: A locator is the device that does the locating: a GPS unit, a radio tag, or a sonar beacon.
normal.cn: locator 是执行定位的装置：全球定位仪、无线电标签或声呐信标。

normal.en: Location and locality both come from locus, one naming a point and the other a neighbourhood.
normal.cn: location 与 locality 都出自 locus，一个命名一个点，另一个命名一片街区。

abstract.en: A pin dropped on a paper map: the whole world is flattened, and one point is chosen.
abstract.cn: 一枚图钉落在纸质地图上：整个世界被压平，其中一个点被选中。

abstract.en: A coordinate grid: the place is not a thing but a pair of numbers where two lines cross.
abstract.cn: 一张坐标网格：地点不是一个物件，而是两条线相交处的一对数字。

abstract.en: A searchlight sweeps a dark field, then locks onto one spot; locating is the moment the beam stops moving.
abstract.cn: 探照灯扫过黑暗的场地，然后锁定一处；定位就是光束停止移动的那一刻。

examples.en: The app can locate your phone within a few metres.
examples.cn: 这个应用能在几米范围内定位你的手机。

examples.en: The new campus is located beside the river.
examples.cn: 新校区坐落在河边。

examples.en: Investigators located the leak beneath the kitchen floor.
examples.cn: 调查人员确定了厨房地板下的漏水点。

dict_mnemonic.text: “楼凯特”——凯特在楼里找到了自己的座位 → locate 找到位置

root: 拉丁语 locare“放置”，来自 locus“地点”；核心是“给某物指定或找到它的位置”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of locate, all from the Latin idea of a place: find the place, occupy a place, give a place, settle an institution, pinpoint a fault, fix a signal, find a passage, map a gene, and finally the boundary between finding and pinpointing.
sensesIntro.cn: locate 的九个义项都出自拉丁语“地点”这一观念：找到地点、占据地点、给予地点、让机构落户、锁定故障、确定信号、查到段落、标出基因，最后是“发现”与“精确定位”的边界。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pin is placed on one exact point of a map.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚图钉被按在地图的某一个精确点上。

branches.en: FINDING: searching ends when the exact point is identified, whether it is a person or a fault.
branches.cn: 寻找：当确切点被认出时搜索结束，无论对象是人还是故障。

branches.en: POSITION: a thing either occupies a place or is deliberately given one.
branches.cn: 位置：某物要么占据一个地点，要么被有意赋予一个地点。

branches.en: INSTITUTIONS AND TEXTS: a branch settles on a site, and a reader puts a finger on a passage.
branches.cn: 机构与文本：分支在场地落户，读者把手指按到某个段落。

branches.en: MEASUREMENT: instruments and genetic maps turn place into coordinates.
branches.cn: 测量：仪器与遗传图谱把地点变成坐标。

branches.en: BOUNDARY: locate demands an exact position, unlike the broader find.
branches.cn: 边界：locate 要求确切位置，不同于更宽泛的 find。

intro.en: Locate is a Latin verb borrowed whole. English adds -ion, -or, -ed and the prefix re- to build location, locator, located and relocate.
intro.cn: locate 是整体借入的拉丁动词。英语通过 -ion、-or、-ed 以及前缀 re- 构成 location、locator、located 与 relocate。

latinIntro.en: The Latin family is built on locus 'place': local, locality, allocate and locomotion all assign, belong to, or move through a place.
latinIntro.cn: 这一拉丁词族建立在 locus“地点”上：local、locality、allocate、locomotion 都涉及指派地点、属于某地或穿行于地点之间。

items.meaning: a place or position; the act of locating
items.meaningCN: 位置；地点；定位行为（-ion 构成行为或结果名词）
items.example: The location of the new station has not been decided.
items.exampleCN: 新车站的位置尚未确定。

items.meaning: a device or person that finds positions
items.meaningCN: 定位器；定位装置（-or 表示执行该动作的物）
items.example: The rescue team carried a radio locator.
items.exampleCN: 救援队携带了一台无线电定位器。

items.meaning: situated in a particular place
items.meaningCN: 位于……的；坐落于……的（-ed 构成形容词）
items.example: The office is located above the library.
items.exampleCN: 办公室位于图书馆上方。

items.meaning: to move something to a new place
items.meaningCN: 迁移；重新安置（re- 表示“再次、重新”）
items.example: The factory relocated to a larger site.
items.exampleCN: 工厂迁到了更大的场地。

items.meaning: a place, a spot
items.example: Every member of the family rests on this noun.
items.exampleCN: 这一词族的每个成员都建立在这个名词上。

items.meaning: place (combining form)
items.example: The stem carries the idea of place into English.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干把“地点”带入英语。

items.meaning: to make, to act
items.example: It forms the verb locate from the place noun.
items.exampleCN: 它由“地点”名词构成动词 locate。

items.meaning: an act or its result
items.example: It forms location, the act or result of placing.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 location，即定位的动作或结果。

items.meaning: to place together; to occur together
items.example: The two terms collocate in academic writing.
items.exampleCN: 这两个词在学术写作中常搭配出现。

latinEntries.meaning: a particular place or position; in genetics, the site of a gene
latinEntries.meaningCN: 地点；位置；基因座（直接来自拉丁语 locus）

latinEntries.meaning: belonging to a particular area
latinEntries.meaningCN: 地方的；当地的（与特定地区有关）

latinEntries.meaning: to assign something for a particular purpose
latinEntries.meaningCN: 分配；拨给（把资源“放置”到某个用途上）

latinEntries.meaning: movement from one place to another
latinEntries.meaningCN: 移动；运动（从一个地点移动到另一个地点）

definition_zh: 逻辑；逻辑学；推理；条理；内在道理
definition_en: the study of valid reasoning; a system or process of reasoning; the sense or rationale behind something
core_image: 一排排前提像齿轮咬合，转动第一只，结论便被迫转到终点
scene: 辩论赛上，反方用三段论一步步推进。Their logic took the other side's premise and pushed it until it contradicted itself, and the judges drew the chain on paper.
sceneCN: 这里 logic 是「逻辑推理」（第 2 个义项：从前提推出结论的过程）；句意：他们的推理拿对方的前提一步步往下推，直到自相矛盾，评委在纸上画出这条推理链。图中可辨识物件：辩论台、写满前提与箭头的纸、评委的笔、计时器。

pos.zh: 逻辑；逻辑学；推理；条理；内在道理

collocations.zh: 顺着推理走；按逻辑推下去

forms.label: 复数（多于一个，指多套逻辑体系）

derivatives.zh: 不合逻辑的；缺乏条理的

senses.title: The discipline: the study of valid inference
senses.titleCN: 学科：研究有效推理的逻辑学
senses.definition: the branch of philosophy and science that studies the forms of valid reasoning
senses.definitionCN: 研究有效推理形式的哲学与科学分支
senses.example: She studied logic before turning to computer science.
senses.exampleCN: 她在转向计算机科学之前学过逻辑学。
senses.why: Greek logikē tekhnē was the 'art of reasoning', built on logos, 'word, reason, account'. The first sense is therefore the organized discipline that teaches how accounts must hang together.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 logikē tekhnē 是“推理之术”，建立在 logos“言词、理性、说明”之上。因此第一个义项就是教人如何让论述环环相扣的那门有组织的学科。

senses.title: The process: reasoning from premises
senses.titleCN: 过程：从前提推出结论
senses.definition: the process of drawing a conclusion from premises according to consistent rules
senses.definitionCN: 依照一致的规则从前提出发推出结论的过程
senses.example: The detective's logic led her to the only possible suspect.
senses.exampleCN: 侦探的推理把她引向唯一可能的嫌疑人。
senses.why: The discipline becomes an activity: a mind moves from what it accepts to what follows. The gears of the core image turn, and the conclusion is carried along whether one likes it or not.
senses.whyCN: 学科变成一种活动：心智从它接受的前提走向必然得出的结论。核心意象里的齿轮转动，结论不管人喜不喜欢都被带到终点。

senses.title: Sensible consistency: there is logic in it
senses.titleCN: 条理：事情说得通、前后一致
senses.definition: the quality of being sensible, consistent, or reasonable
senses.definitionCN: 明智、前后一致或合乎情理的性质
senses.example: There is a certain logic in her decision, even if I dislike it.
senses.exampleCN: 她的决定自有其道理，尽管我并不喜欢。
senses.why: When an account holds together, we say it has logic. The word moves from the formal rules to the everyday impression that nothing in the story contradicts anything else.
senses.whyCN: 当一个说法前后立得住，我们就说它有逻辑。这个词从形式规则转向日常印象：故事里没有任何一处与另一处相矛盾。

senses.title: Inner rationale: the logic of a situation
senses.titleCN: 内在道理：局势自身的运行逻辑
senses.definition: the underlying rationale that makes a situation, system, or institution work as it does
senses.definitionCN: 使某种局势、制度或体系如此运作的深层道理
senses.example: The logic of the market rewards speed over craftsmanship.
senses.exampleCN: 市场的逻辑奖励速度，而不是手艺。
senses.why: A system has its own forced sequence: given its rules, certain outcomes follow. Calling this its logic treats the system as an argument whose conclusion is already built in.
senses.whyCN: 一个体系有自己的强制序列：给定其规则，某些结果就会随之而来。把它称为“逻辑”，就是把该体系当作一个结论早已内置的论证。

senses.title: A formal system: Aristotelian, modal, fuzzy logic
senses.titleCN: 形式体系：亚里士多德逻辑、模态逻辑、模糊逻辑
senses.definition: a particular formal system of rules for valid inference, such as classical, modal, or fuzzy logic
senses.definitionCN: 某一套关于有效推理的形式规则体系，如经典逻辑、模态逻辑或模糊逻辑
senses.example: Modal logic adds rules for statements about necessity and possibility.
senses.exampleCN: 模态逻辑为关于必然性与可能性的陈述增加了规则。
senses.why: There is not one logic but many. Each system fixes its own symbols, axioms, and permitted moves, so 'a logic' names a game with explicit rules rather than reasoning in general.
senses.whyCN: 逻辑不止一套，而是有许多套。每个体系固定自己的符号、公理与允许的步骤，因此“一套逻辑”命名的是一场规则明确的游戏，而不是一般意义上的推理。

senses.title: Digital logic: gates and circuits
senses.titleCN: 数字逻辑：逻辑门与电路
senses.definition: the branch of electronics in which signals are combined by Boolean operations such as AND, OR, and NOT
senses.definitionCN: 电子学中用电平信号按与、或、非等布尔运算组合的分支
senses.example: The chip contains thousands of logic gates.
senses.exampleCN: 这块芯片包含数千个逻辑门。
senses.why: Formal rules become hardware: true and false turn into high and low voltage, and a gate output follows its inputs exactly as a conclusion follows premises. The abstract chain is now etched in silicon.
senses.whyCN: 形式规则变成硬件：真与假转为高电平与低电平，逻辑门的输出严格跟随输入，就像结论跟随前提。抽象的推理链此时被刻进硅片。

senses.title: Program logic: rules that decide behaviour
senses.titleCN: 程序逻辑：决定行为的规则
senses.definition: in computing, the set of rules in a program that determine how it responds to input
senses.definitionCN: 在计算机领域，程序中决定如何响应输入的一组规则
senses.example: The payment logic rejects cards with expired dates.
senses.exampleCN: 支付逻辑会拒绝过期日期的银行卡。
senses.why: Software encodes if-then structures: under condition A, do B. Business logic is the reasoning of an institution written as executable rules, so the same word covers both thought and machine.
senses.whyCN: 软件把“如果—那么”结构编码：在条件 A 下执行 B。业务逻辑就是把机构的推理写成可执行的规则，因此同一个词同时覆盖思维与机器。

senses.title: Argument structure: the chain from premise to conclusion
senses.titleCN: 论证结构：从前提到结论的链条
senses.definition: the structure of an argument, especially the relation between its premises and its conclusion
senses.definitionCN: 论证的结构，尤指前提与结论之间的关系
senses.example: The essay has a clear logic: each paragraph answers the objection raised before.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章逻辑清晰：每一段都回应前一段提出的反驳。
senses.why: Here logic is neither a discipline nor an inner rationale but the visible skeleton of a text. Each part must be held by the part before it, or the chain of proof breaks.
senses.whyCN: 这里的 logic 既不是学科，也不是内在道理，而是文本可见的骨架。每一部分都必须被前一部分扣住，否则证明链就断了。

senses.title: Usage boundary: countable only as a system
senses.titleCN: 用法边界：只有指“体系”时才可数
senses.definition: a usage limit: logic is usually uncountable; a logic or logics is used only for distinct formal systems, and logic is not a synonym for opinion or feeling
senses.definitionCN: 用法限制：logic 通常不可数；a logic 或 logics 只用于不同的形式体系，且 logic 不是 opinion 或 feeling 的同义词
senses.example: His anger is real, but it is not an argument in logic.
senses.exampleCN: 他的愤怒是真实的，但它在逻辑上不构成论据。
senses.why: The mass noun names reasoning as a substance, not a set of opinions. Counting begins only when separate rule-systems are compared. Emotion can motivate a claim, but it cannot supply the force of a conclusion.
senses.whyCN: 这个不可数名词把推理视作一种“质料”，而不是一堆观点。只有比较彼此独立的规则体系时才开始计数。情绪可以促使人提出主张，却不能提供结论的力量。

intro.en: Logic reaches English through Greek, Latin, and French. The chain logos to logikē to logica to logique is well documented; the Indo-European root *leg- is generally believed rather than certain.
intro.cn: logic 经由希腊语、拉丁语和法语进入英语。从 logos 到 logikē、logica、logique 的链条有清楚记载；其印欧词根 *leg- 只是一般认为，并非确定。

items.en: Greek logos meant 'word, speech, account, reason'. It could name a story told, an explanation given, or the rational order behind things.
items.cn: 希腊语 logos 意为“言词、言语、说明、理性”。它既可以指讲述的故事、给出的解释，也可以指事物背后的理性秩序。

items.en: Logos is generally traced to PIE *leg- 'to gather, pick up', specifically 'to pick words'. Speaking is pictured as gathering words and putting them in order; the deeper link is generally believed, not proved.
items.cn: logos 一般追溯到原始印欧语 *leg-“采集、拾起”，尤指“挑选词语”。说话被想象成把词语采集起来并排成次序；这一更深联系属于一般认为是，而非已经证明。

items.en: Logikē (tekhnē) meant the 'art of reasoning', the skill of using logoi well. Aristotle's works on argument turned that skill into a systematic study.
items.cn: logikē (tekhnē) 意为“推理之术”，即善用 logoi 的技能。亚里士多德关于论证的著作把这种技能变成了系统研究。

items.en: Latin logica and Old French logique carried the word westward. In the medieval curriculum logic was one of the three basic arts, alongside grammar and rhetoric.
items.cn: 拉丁语 logica 与古法语 logique 把这个词带到西方。在中世纪课程中，逻辑学与语法、修辞并列为三门基础技艺。

items.en: English logic appears in the 14c. Mathematical logic develops in the 19c., and digital logic in the 20c. gives the old art of reasoning a silicon body.
items.cn: 英语 logic 出现于 14 世纪。数理逻辑在 19 世纪发展起来，数字逻辑在 20 世纪给这门古老的推理之术装上了硅制的身体。

note.en: The first group shares the logos root or the log- shape; the second separates the discipline from reasoning, rationale, consistency, and one specific inference type.
note.cn: 第一组共享 logos 词根或 log- 词形；第二组把“逻辑学”与推理、根据、一致性以及一种具体推理类型分开。

entries.definition: following the rules of logic; sensible and consistent. It is the adjective built on logic.
entries.definitionCN: 符合逻辑规则的；有条理的。它是 logic 构成的形容词。

entries.definition: the organized movement and supply of goods and people. It comes from Greek logistikos 'skilled in calculating', also from logos.
entries.definitionCN: 货物与人员的有组织调运和供给。它来自希腊语 logistikos“擅长计算”，同样出自 logos。

entries.definition: a symbol or design used as a brand mark. It is shortened from logotype, from Greek logos 'word'.
entries.definitionCN: 用作品牌标记的符号或图案。它由 logotype 缩略而来，源自希腊语 logos“言词”。

entries.definition: the mental process of thinking things through. It is broader than logic and can include informal, practical thought.
entries.definitionCN: 把事情想通的思维过程。它比 logic 宽泛，可以包括非正式的、实践性的思考。

entries.definition: the reasons or explanation behind a decision or system. It names the content, not the formal study of inference.
entries.definitionCN: 某一决定或体系背后的理由或解释。它命名内容，而不是对推理的形式研究。

entries.definition: the property of parts fitting together without contradiction. It is one test of logic, not logic itself.
entries.definitionCN: 各部分彼此相容、不矛盾的性质。它是逻辑的一项检验，而不是逻辑本身。

entries.definition: inference from general premises to a necessary conclusion. It is one branch of logic, not the whole field.
entries.definitionCN: 从一般前提到必然结论的推理。它是逻辑学的一个分支，而不是整个领域。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: logos as word and reason, the real phrases formal logic and logic gate, and the everyday 'there is no logic in it'.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：作为言词与理性的 logos、真实短语 formal logic 与 logic gate，以及日常说法“毫无逻辑”。

normal.en: Logos meant 'word, account, reason'; logic is the art of making an account hold together.
normal.cn: logos 意为“言词、说明、理性”；logic 就是让一套说明站得住的技术。

normal.en: Formal logic writes the rules down: if the premises are true and the form is valid, the conclusion must be true.
normal.cn: formal logic 把规则写下来：如果前提为真且形式有效，结论必然为真。

normal.en: The logic of a situation is its inner forced sequence: given those rules, this outcome follows.
normal.cn: the logic of a situation 指局势内在的强制序列：给定那些规则，这个结果就会随之而来。

normal.en: A logic gate is the same reasoning in hardware: high and low inputs produce an output by rule.
normal.cn: 逻辑门是同一套推理的硬件版本：高、低输入按规则产生输出。

normal.en: Logical and illogical split the world into what follows and what contradicts itself.
normal.cn: logical 与 illogical 把世界分成两类：推得下去的，和自相矛盾的。

abstract.en: A chain of premises: each link is forced, and the last link cannot refuse the pull of the first.
abstract.cn: 一条前提链：每一环都是被迫的，最后一环无法拒绝第一环的拉力。

abstract.en: A transparent machine: put premises in at the top, and only the conclusion comes out at the bottom; emotion stays outside.
abstract.cn: 一台透明的机器：前提从上方放入，只有结论从下方出来；情绪留在机器之外。

abstract.en: A skeleton that holds an argument upright: remove one bone and the whole body of proof collapses.
abstract.cn: 一副撑起论证的骨架：抽掉一根骨头，整个证明的身体就塌了。

examples.en: The argument is elegant, but its logic is flawed at the second step.
examples.cn: 这个论证很漂亮，但它的逻辑在第二步就有漏洞。

examples.en: There is a simple logic to her method: test the cheapest fix first.
examples.cn: 她的方法有一个简单的内在道理：先试最便宜的修法。

examples.en: Modern processors are built from millions of logic gates.
examples.cn: 现代处理器由数百万个逻辑门构成。

dict_mnemonic.text: “老季克”——老季讲话条理清楚，句句都推得下去 → logic 逻辑

root: 希腊语 logos“言词、理性、说明”，经 logikē tekhnē“推理之术”而来；核心是“用有章法的言词把道理讲通”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of logic, all from logos as ordered speech: the discipline, the act of reasoning, the feel of consistency, the rationale inside a system, a formal rule-system, silicon gates, program rules, the skeleton of an argument, and the boundary of countable uses.
sensesIntro.cn: logic 的九个义项都出自 logos 作为“有秩序的言词”：学科、推理行为、前后一致的感觉、体系内的道理、形式规则体系、硅片上的门、程序规则、论证骨架，以及可数用法的边界。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: ordered words lock together and force a conclusion.
core.cn: 核心意象：有次序的言词彼此咬合，迫使结论出现。

branches.en: THE DISCIPLINE AND ITS SYSTEMS: logic is both the study of valid form and the named formal systems it compares.
branches.cn: 学科及其体系：logic 既是对有效形式的研究，也是它所比较的各套具名形式体系。

branches.en: THE ACT AND THE SKELETON: reasoning moves from premise to conclusion, and the written argument shows that chain.
branches.cn: 行为与骨架：推理从前提到结论，书面论证则展示这条链。

branches.en: CONSISTENCY AND RATIONALE: an account holds together, and a system carries its own forced logic.
branches.cn: 一致性与内在道理：一套说明前后立得住，一个体系则带有自身强制的逻辑。

branches.en: MACHINES: Boolean gates and program rules turn inference into hardware and code.
branches.cn: 机器：布尔门与程序规则把推理变成硬件与代码。

branches.en: BOUNDARY: logic is mass-noun reasoning, countable only when separate systems are meant.
branches.cn: 边界：logic 是不可数的推理，只有指彼此独立的体系时才可数。

intro.en: Logic is a Greek-derived noun ending in -ic. English builds the adjective with -al, the adverb with -ally, the person with -ian, and the negative with il-.
intro.cn: logic 是源自希腊语、以 -ic 结尾的名词。英语用 -al 构成形容词，用 -ally 构成副词，用 -ian 构成人物名词，用 il- 构成否定。

latinIntro.en: The family rests on Greek logos 'word, reason'. Dialogue, monologue, logistics and analogy all contain that same second element or its derivative.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词族建立在希腊语 logos“言词、理性”上。dialogue、monologue、logistics、analogy 都含有同一词素或其派生形式。

items.meaning: following the rules of logic; sensible
items.meaningCN: 逻辑的；合乎逻辑的（-al 表示“与……有关”）
items.example: That is the logical conclusion from the evidence.
items.exampleCN: 那是从证据得出的合乎逻辑的结论。

items.meaning: in a way that follows from the premises
items.meaningCN: 逻辑上；合乎逻辑地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: Logically, the second claim depends on the first.
items.exampleCN: 从逻辑上说，第二个主张依赖于第一个。

items.meaning: a person who studies or works with logic
items.meaningCN: 逻辑学家（-ian 表示从事该学科的人）
items.example: The logician rewrote the proof in symbols.
items.exampleCN: 这位逻辑学家用符号重写了证明。

items.meaning: not following from the premises; inconsistent
items.meaningCN: 不合逻辑的；缺乏条理的（il- 表示否定）
items.example: It is illogical to expect a different result from the same input.
items.exampleCN: 指望同样的输入产生不同的结果是不合逻辑的。

items.meaning: word, speech, reason
items.example: The noun is the source of logic and of -logy.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是 logic 与 -logy 的来源。

items.meaning: word, reason (combining form)
items.example: The stem appears in dialogue, catalogue and logic.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干见于 dialogue、catalogue 与 logic。

items.meaning: relating to, concerned with
items.example: It shapes logical, the adjective built on logic.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 logical 这一形容词。

items.meaning: an art or a study
items.example: The ending marks logic as a discipline, logike in Greek.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把 logic 标为一门学问，希腊语作 logike。

items.meaning: a formal argument from two premises
items.example: The syllogism is the oldest tool of formal logic.
items.exampleCN: 三段论是形式逻辑最古老的工具。

latinEntries.meaning: a conversation between two or more people
latinEntries.meaningCN: 对话；对白（dia- 表示“之间”，logos 表示“言词”）

latinEntries.meaning: a long speech by one person
latinEntries.meaningCN: 独白；长篇独语（mono- 表示“单一”）

latinEntries.meaning: the organized supply and movement of goods and people
latinEntries.meaningCN: 物流；后勤（源自“擅长计算”，与 logos 同族）

latinEntries.meaning: a comparison based on a shared relation
latinEntries.meaningCN: 类比；类推（按相同的比例或关系作比较）

definition_zh: 维持；保养；供养；坚称；捍卫
definition_en: to keep something at the same level or in good condition, to support someone financially, or to state and defend a position
core_image: 一只手从下方托住重物，掌心始终不松，重物因此停在原处
scene: 长跑教练在赛道边提醒队员。He told them to maintain this pace and not to chase the runners ahead, so that the whole group kept an even rhythm of breathing.
sceneCN: 这里 maintain 是「维持、保持」（第 1 个义项：把速度维持在原有水平）；句意：他让队员保持这个配速，不要去追前面的人，好让整队保持均匀的呼吸节奏。图中可辨识物件：跑道、配速表、队员队列、教练手势。

pos.zh: 维持；保养；供养；坚称；捍卫

derivatives.zh: 维持；保养；维护费；生活费

senses.title: Keep at a level: hold a state steady
senses.titleCN: 维持水平：让状态保持不坠
senses.definition: to keep something at a particular level, rate, or state over time
senses.definitionCN: 使某物在一段时间内保持在特定水平、速度或状态
senses.example: The pilot maintained a steady altitude through the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 飞行员在暴风雨中保持了稳定的高度。
senses.why: Latin manu tenere meant 'to hold with the hand'. The first sense is the plain physical image: a hand under a weight, neither lifting nor dropping it, so the level stays the same.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 manu tenere 意为“用手握住”。第一个义项就是最朴素的实体画面：一只手托着重物，既不举起也不放下，因此高度保持不变。

senses.title: Keep in good repair: service equipment
senses.titleCN: 保养：让设备保持可用
senses.definition: to keep a building, machine, or system in good working condition by regular checks and repairs
senses.definitionCN: 通过定期检查与修理，使建筑、机器或系统保持良好工作状态
senses.example: The crew maintains the bridge every spring.
senses.exampleCN: 养护队每年春天保养这座桥。
senses.why: A machine is held up by care: oil, parts, inspections. The hand now holds not a weight but a working order, and letting go means decay.
senses.whyCN: 机器靠照料才被“托住”：润滑油、零件、检查。手此时握住的不是重物，而是工作状态；一旦松手，就是衰败。

senses.title: Support financially: provide for someone
senses.titleCN: 供养：提供生活所需
senses.definition: to provide money or resources for someone to live on
senses.definitionCN: 为某人提供生活所需的金钱或资源
senses.example: One salary was not enough to maintain a family of five.
senses.exampleCN: 一份工资不足以供养五口之家。
senses.why: To hold someone up can be economic: the hand supplies what keeps a household standing. The same verb that holds a level also holds people above poverty.
senses.whyCN: “托住某人”可以是经济上的：手提供让一个家庭站稳的东西。同一个表示“维持水平”的动词，也用来表示让人不至于陷入贫困。

senses.title: Assert as true: maintain that
senses.titleCN: 坚称：坚持认为某事为真
senses.definition: to state something firmly as true, especially when others doubt it
senses.definitionCN: 坚定地陈述某事为真，尤在他人怀疑时
senses.example: The company maintains that its product is safe.
senses.exampleCN: 公司坚称其产品是安全的。
senses.why: A claim is held the way a position is held: you keep it standing against pressure. The hand switches from supporting objects to supporting a proposition.
senses.whyCN: 一个主张被“握住”的方式，就像一个阵地被守住：你在压力下让它立着。手从托住物件转为托住一个命题。

senses.title: Defend a position: stand one's ground
senses.titleCN: 捍卫立场：守住自己的阵地
senses.definition: to defend or uphold an opinion, right, or position against opposition
senses.definitionCN: 面对反对仍捍卫或坚持某种意见、权利或立场
senses.example: She maintained her innocence throughout the trial.
senses.exampleCN: 整个审判期间她都坚持自己是无辜的。
senses.why: This is the military edge of the hand image: holding a line under attack. The assertion is not merely spoken but kept in place while others push against it.
senses.whyCN: 这是“手”的意象中带军事意味的一面：在攻击下守住一条线。主张不只是被说出，而是在别人推挤时仍被保持在原位。

senses.title: Keep records or accounts systematically
senses.titleCN: 维护记录：让账目持续完整
senses.definition: to keep records, accounts, or lists in an orderly and continuing way
senses.definitionCN: 以有序且持续的方式保存记录、账目或清单
senses.example: The lab maintains detailed logs of every experiment.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室维护每次实验的详细日志。
senses.why: A record is a structure that collapses if nobody holds it: entries must be added, errors corrected, gaps filled. Maintaining is the regular hand that keeps the file from falling into disorder.
senses.whyCN: 记录是一种若无人托住就会塌的结构：要新增条目、修正错误、填补空缺。维护就是那只定期伸出的手，让档案不至于陷入混乱。

senses.title: Keep a system running: technical upkeep
senses.titleCN: 系统维护：让系统持续运行
senses.definition: to keep a network, website, or software system running and updated
senses.definitionCN: 使网络、网站或软件系统持续运行并及时更新
senses.example: Two engineers maintain the server around the clock.
senses.exampleCN: 两名工程师全天候维护服务器。
senses.why: Digital systems also fall if unsupported: patches, backups, monitoring. The verb extends from a physical machine to an invisible service that must be held online.
senses.whyCN: 数字系统若无人支持也会倒下：补丁、备份、监控。动词从实体机器延伸到必须被“托在线上”的无形服务。

senses.title: Keep health or weight stable
senses.titleCN: 保持健康或体重稳定
senses.definition: to keep one's body weight, health, or condition at a stable level
senses.definitionCN: 使体重、健康或身体状态保持在稳定水平
senses.example: He maintains his weight by walking to work.
senses.exampleCN: 他靠步行上班来保持体重。
senses.why: The body is the most intimate thing held steady. Maintaining weight is a daily counter-pressure against gain and loss, exactly the small continuous effort of the hand.
senses.whyCN: 身体是被维持得最切身的东西。保持体重，就是每天对增重与减重施加反向压力，正好对应那只手持续不断的小小用力。

senses.title: Usage boundary: formal upkeep, not mere keeping
senses.titleCN: 用法边界：正式的维护，不等于简单保留
senses.definition: a usage limit: maintain is more formal than keep, implies continuing effort, and maintain that is a formal way to report an assertion
senses.definitionCN: 用法限制：maintain 比 keep 正式，含持续付出的意味；maintain that 是转述某人主张的正式说法
senses.example: She keeps a spare key; the building manager maintains the locks.
senses.exampleCN: 她留着一把备用钥匙；物业经理负责维护门锁。
senses.why: Keeping can be passive possession; maintaining requires active care. The word also reports a claim without endorsing it, so a news report can say 'the minister maintains' while leaving the truth open.
senses.whyCN: keep 可以只是被动地保有；maintain 则要求主动照料。这个词还能在不背书的情况下转述主张，因此新闻报道可以写“部长坚称”，同时把真假留空。

intro.en: Maintain comes from Latin manu tenere 'to hold with the hand', through Old French maintenir. The hand-to-support chain is unusually clear; only the ultimate Indo-European root of tenere is less certain.
intro.cn: maintain 经由古法语 maintenir 来自拉丁语 manu tenere“用手握住”。从“手”到“维持”的引申链异常清楚；只有 tenere 最深的印欧词源较不确定。

items.en: Latin manus meant 'hand'. Its ablative form manu appears in phrases describing holding, seizing, and handing over.
items.cn: 拉丁语 manus 意为“手”。它的夺格形式 manu 出现在描述握住、抓取和交接的短语中。

items.en: Manu tenere meant literally 'to hold with the hand'. The phrase already implies keeping something from falling, which is the seed of every later sense.
items.cn: manu tenere 字面义就是“用手握住”。这个短语已经隐含“不让某物掉下去”，这正是后来所有义项的种子。

items.en: Old French maintenir meant 'to support, sustain, keep up; preserve'. French fused the Latin phrase into one verb and passed it to English.
items.cn: 古法语 maintenir 意为“支撑、维持、托住；保存”。法语把这个拉丁短语融合成一个动词，再传给英语。

items.en: English maintain is recorded in the 14c. with the senses 'to support, uphold, preserve' and soon also 'to assert, affirm'.
items.cn: 英语 maintain 在 14 世纪有记录，义为“支撑、维护、保存”，很快又出现“断言、坚称”义。

items.en: The chain runs from hand-hold to sustain, then to provide for, keep in repair, keep records, and finally hold a claim against doubt. Each step keeps the idea of not letting something fall.
items.cn: 引申链从“手持”到“支撑”，再到“供养”“保养”“维护记录”，最后到“在怀疑中守住一个主张”。每一步都保留“不让某物掉下去”的意思。

items.en: Modern English maintains bridges, servers, records, weight and arguments. Maintenance, with its shifted spelling, names the whole work of keeping things up.
items.cn: 现代英语 maintain 可以带桥梁、服务器、记录、体重和论点。拼写发生变化的 maintenance 则命名整套“让东西不倒”的工作。

note.en: The first group shares the maintain shape and the irregular noun maintenance; the second separates upkeep, endurance, protection, and assertion.
note.cn: 第一组共享 maintain 的词形与不规则名词 maintenance；第二组区分维护、持续支撑、保护和断言。

entries.definition: the work of keeping something in good condition, or the money needed to support it. Its spelling differs from maintain.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物保持良好状态的工作，或维持它所需的费用。它的拼写与 maintain 不同。

entries.definition: able to be kept up or defended. It is maintain plus -able.
entries.definitionCN: 可维持的；可维护的；可辩护的。它是 maintain 加 -able。

entries.definition: a person or thing that keeps something in working order. It is maintain plus -er.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物保持正常运转的人或物。它是 maintain 加 -er。

entries.definition: to continue to have or hold something in a particular state. It is more general and less formal than maintain.
entries.definitionCN: 继续保有某物或使其处于某种状态。它比 maintain 更一般、更不正式。

entries.definition: to keep something going over a long period, especially with resources or effort. It stresses endurance more than routine care.
entries.definitionCN: 在较长时期内让某物持续，尤指靠资源或努力。它比日常维护更强调持久承受。

entries.definition: to keep something in its original state and protect it from harm or decay. It focuses on preventing change.
entries.definitionCN: 使某物保持原状并防止受损或腐坏。它聚焦于阻止变化。

entries.definition: to state a fact or belief firmly. It overlaps maintain that, but carries no idea of upkeep.
entries.definitionCN: 坚定地陈述事实或信念。它与 maintain that 重叠，但不含“维护、保养”的意思。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the Latin phrase manu tenere, the real collocations maintain order and maintain that, and the irregular noun maintenance.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：拉丁短语 manu tenere、真实搭配 maintain order 与 maintain that，以及不规则名词 maintenance。

normal.en: Manu tenere is 'to hold with the hand'; maintain is what a hand does when it refuses to let something drop.
normal.cn: manu tenere 就是“用手握住”；maintain 就是手不肯让东西掉下去时所做的动作。

normal.en: Maintain order means keeping a crowd or system from falling into disorder, one small correction at a time.
normal.cn: maintain order 指让一群人一个系统不陷入混乱，靠一次次小小的修正。

normal.en: Maintain equipment is routine care: oil, inspect, replace worn parts before they fail.
normal.cn: maintain equipment 是日常照料：上油、检查、在零件失效前更换。

normal.en: Maintain that ... reports a firm claim without saying whether the speaker agrees.
normal.cn: maintain that……转述一个坚定的主张，却不说明转述者是否同意。

normal.en: The noun is maintenance, not maintainance: the spelling shifted after the French noun.
normal.cn: 名词是 maintenance，不是 maintainance：拼写随法语名词发生了变化。

abstract.en: A hand under a falling object, applying just enough upward force to cancel gravity: maintain is continuous counter-pressure.
abstract.cn: 一只手托住下落的物体，施加刚好抵消重力的向上力：maintain 就是持续的反向压力。

abstract.en: A tightrope walker makes tiny corrections all the time; the walk looks still, but maintaining it is constant motion.
abstract.cn: 走钢丝的人一直在做微小修正；行走看似静止，维持它却是持续的运动。

abstract.en: A bridge is kept alive by paint nobody notices: maintenance is invisible until it stops.
abstract.cn: 一座桥靠没人注意的油漆活着：维护在停止之前都是看不见的。

examples.en: The team maintained its lead until the final minute.
examples.cn: 这支队伍把领先优势保持到最后一分钟。

examples.en: Regular checks maintain the machine far better than urgent repairs.
examples.cn: 定期检查保养机器，远胜于紧急抢修。

examples.en: The report maintains that the new policy has reduced waiting times.
examples.cn: 报告坚称新政策缩短了等待时间。

dict_mnemonic.text: “曼特恩”——曼特恩每天给机器上油，让它一直转下去 → maintain 维持、保养

root: 拉丁语 manu tenere“用手握住”＝manu（manus“手”的夺格）+ tenere“握持”；核心是“手不松开，东西就不倒”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of maintain, all from one hand: hold a level, service a machine, support a family, hold a claim, defend a line, keep records, keep a system online, keep the body steady, and finally the boundary between passive keeping and active upkeep.
sensesIntro.cn: maintain 的九个义项都出自同一只手：托住水平、保养机器、供养家庭、托住主张、守住防线、维护记录、让系统在线、让身体稳定，最后是“被动保有”与“主动维护”的边界。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand holds a weight from below and never lets go.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手从下方托住重物，始终不松开。

branches.en: LEVEL AND REPAIR: a hand keeps a height steady, or keeps a machine from decaying.
branches.cn: 水平与修缮：手让高度保持稳定，或让机器不至于衰败。

branches.en: PROVISION: holding someone up becomes paying for their living.
branches.cn: 供养：托住一个人变成支付他的生活所需。

branches.en: CLAIM AND DEFENCE: a proposition is held against doubt, and a position is held under attack.
branches.cn: 主张与辩护：在怀疑中托住一个命题，在攻击下守住一个立场。

branches.en: SYSTEMS: records and servers stay usable only while someone keeps holding them up.
branches.cn: 系统：记录与服务器只有在有人持续托住时才保持可用。

branches.en: BODY AND BOUNDARY: weight is kept steady, while maintain is distinguished from mere keeping by effort and formality.
branches.cn: 身体与边界：体重被保持稳定；同时 maintain 以“付出与正式度”区别于单纯的 keep。

intro.en: Maintain is a French verb that came from a Latin phrase, not a prefixed English word. English adds -ance, -able, -er and -ed; the noun maintenance shows a spelling shift.
intro.cn: maintain 是从拉丁短语来的法语动词，不是带前缀的英语词。英语加 -ance、-able、-er、-ed；名词 maintenance 显示了拼写变化。

latinIntro.en: The Latin family is built on manus 'hand': manual, manuscript, manufacture and manumit all describe work, writing, making, or releasing by hand.
latinIntro.cn: 这一拉丁词族建立在 manus“手”上：manual、manuscript、manufacture、manumit 都描述用手操作、书写、制造或释放。

items.meaning: the work of keeping something in good condition; the cost of support
items.meaningCN: 保养；维护；维持费用（-ance 构成行为或状态名词，拼写有变化）
items.example: The building needs regular maintenance.
items.exampleCN: 这栋建筑需要定期维护。

items.meaning: able to be kept up or defended
items.meaningCN: 可维持的；可维护的；可辩护的（-able 表示“能够被……”）
items.example: The software is designed to be easily maintainable.
items.exampleCN: 这款软件的设计目标是易于维护。

items.meaning: a person or thing that keeps something in working order
items.meaningCN: 维持者；维护者（-er 表示执行该动作的人或物）
items.example: The maintainer of the archive checks it every month.
items.exampleCN: 档案的维护者每月检查一次。

items.meaning: kept in good condition
items.meaningCN: 保养良好的；维持住的（-ed 构成形容词）
items.example: The garden is beautifully maintained.
items.exampleCN: 这座花园维护得很漂亮。

items.meaning: hand
items.example: The hand is the image behind maintain and manual.
items.exampleCN: “手”是 maintain 与 manual 背后的意象。

items.meaning: to hold, to keep
items.example: The verb supplies the holding that maintain describes.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供 maintain 所描述的“握住”。

items.meaning: hand (combining form)
items.example: French passed this hand form into English maintain.
items.exampleCN: 法语把这个“手”的形式传给了英语的 maintain。

items.meaning: to hold (verb ending)
items.example: The same ending appears in retain, contain and sustain.
items.exampleCN: 同一词尾见于 retain、contain 与 sustain。

items.structure: Latin tenens, present participle of tenere
items.meaning: one who holds land of another
items.example: The tenant holds the land without owning it.
items.exampleCN: 承租人持有土地但并不拥有它。

items.meaning: to keep or hold back
items.example: The museum retains the original frame.
items.exampleCN: 博物馆保留了原来的画框。

latinEntries.meaning: done with the hands; a handbook
latinEntries.meaningCN: 手工的；手册（与手有关）

latinEntries.meaning: a document written by hand
latinEntries.meaningCN: 手稿；手写文稿（“用手写成的”）

latinEntries.meaning: to make goods, originally by hand
latinEntries.meaningCN: 制造；生产（原义“用手做成”）

latinEntries.meaning: to release a slave from ownership
latinEntries.meaningCN: 解放（奴隶）；原义“从手中放走”

definition_zh: 主要的；重大的；大调的；主修（科目）；少校；成年人
definition_en: greater in importance, size, or seriousness; of a musical scale built on a major third; as a noun, a main subject of study, a military rank, or a person of full legal age
core_image: 天平上更重的那一端：两边同时放上物件，major 是往下沉的一侧
scene: 开学前一周，她在选课系统里填表。She marked economics as her major and then signed the bottom of the form, which also declared that she was old enough to sign for herself.
sceneCN: 这里 major 是「主修科目」（第 5 个义项：大学里分量最重的学科）；句意：她把经济学标为主修，然后在表格底部签名，这一签也表明她已到了可以自己签字的年龄。图中可辨识物件：选课系统界面、经济学课程条目、签名栏与钢笔。

pos.zh: 主要的；重大的；大调的；成年的
主修科目；少校；成年人；大联盟
